ios.desc:
Finally, a radical anti-distraction app!

Tired of endless scrolling on Instagram or being constantly interrupted by notifications?

Pause blocks all distractions on your phone for a set timer (e.g. 60 min), helping you focus on what truly matters—completely distraction-free! The trick? You can’t bypass the block!

Whether you’re working, studying, reading, sleeping, or just breaking free from the scroll, regain control of your time. Pause helps you disconnect and refocus on what really counts.

Why choose Pause?

- Block distractions: Start a timer, and Pause locks all apps (except essentials like calls and texts) to maximize your focus.
- Achieve your goals: Once the timer starts, there's no way to bypass the block. A true bubble of calm to keep you on track.
- Track your progress: Monitor your productive hours and see how much you’ve accomplished.

Staying focused has never been this easy. Whether you’re a student, freelancer, or entrepreneur, Pause helps you take control of your time and reach your goals.

Download Pause now and experience radical disconnection.
Give yourself a Pause, you deserve it.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Pause – Unbreakable Focus Timer

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built Pause, a radical anti-distraction app that helps you stay focused by blocking all apps with a timer you can’t bypass.

Like many, I often found myself mindlessly scrolling on my phone when I should be working, reading, or just enjoying a break.

App blockers exist, but most can be disabled too easily. Pause is different: there is no way around it – it blocks all your apps, and you have to wait until the timer ends.
Simple and effective – no extra fluff, just deep focus.
It’s perfect for work, study, reading, or reducing phone addiction.

If you’ve ever felt the urge to "just check something real quick" and lost 30 minutes instead, Pause is for you.

Would love your feedback! Download, try it, and let me know what you think.
